description: See the multi-step pricing pipelines Last Price publishes and the stages they are built from: for each reference pipeline its name, what it is for, its topology, latency and cost ceilings, the consent it needs and the trust zones it may run in, and the stage catalogue with each stage's layer and tags. This is discovery only: running a whole pipeline is not available yet and answers 501 rather than a simulated price. To price today use compute_price, or run_pricing_chain for a chain you define. Public: needs no credential.
name: list_pricing_pipelines
